Question: In the UNESCO UIS SDG 4 Education Indicators table for the indicator 'Completion rate, primary education, female (modelled data) (%)', what value is listed for Luxembourg (LUX) in 2023?

A. 99.74488067626952%
B. 98.5797882080078%

Source citation: UNESCO UIS SDG 4 Education Indicators: Completion rate, primary education, female (modelled data) (%) (https://data.unesco.org/api/explore/v2.1/catalog/datasets/uis001/records?where=indicator_id+%3D+%22CR.MOD.1.F%22+and+year+%3D+date%272023-01-01%27&order_by=country_id&limit=100&offset=0)

Supplied draft answer: B
